Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: NEW ORIGINAL PRODUCTION PIXEL ANIMATION SOURCE, not a concept board, not a runtime atlas yet. Reference images are approved art direction ONLY; redraw new per-frame raster pixels, never crop a concept illustration. True transparent RGBA. NO TEXT, labels, guides, borders, scenery, ground backdrop, checkerboard paint, characters, weapons or UI. Detailed crisp wuxia pixel clusters, deliberate limited RED/ORANGE/GOLD fire palette with tiny white-hot cores. No blur, glow fog or vector crescents. Orthographic elevated top-down three-quarter RPG projection, square world plane, NEVER side-scrolling or isometric.
Layout:1536x1024 with EXACTLY6columns x4rows,24isolated effects, equal256x256cells, at least12px clear gutters, each effect completely inside its cell. Each row is one six-frame animation, same size/identity anchored at cell center; do not enlarge/shrink the whole effect across travel loops. Frame1->2->3->4->5->6 sequential shape changes, no labels, no still sliding pretending to animate. Crisp source pixels will be cleaned/aligned at game pixel scale.
ONE GREAT EAST-ASIAN FIRE DRAGON, unmistakable horned head, glowing eye, long serpentine flame body and tapered ember tail, open gaps show ground. No wings, no second head, no generic fire wave. Body ~220long/95high sourcepixels in side heading; uniform length across loop, same horns/muzzle/foreclaw silhouette, animate flame convection and a subtle body undulation, never grow into different dragons. Six travel-loop poses per first3rows; ensure final pose cycles naturally into first.
Row1 RIGHT: head right, body flows left, elevated top view of head/back, entire dragon fits each cell.
Row2 DOWN: head at bottom, tail top, top-down foreshortened full dragon, do not rotate a sideview dragon into vertical standing plane.
Row3 UP: head top, tail bottom, full back/top dragon, same projection.
Row4 IMPACT: six frame ground-level dragon-jaw flame burst progression, initial head crest opens -> bright jaws/contact at frame3 -> broken flame ribbons -> sparse ember ending. No traveling dragon in this impact row; no opaque blast disc. Keep empty center gaps and horizontal ground perspective.
